public.text: The section says the architecture is organised across two “distinct but related layers,” but later figures and descriptions refer to additional layers and cross-cutting elements, including functional applications, foundational DPI, cross-cutting enablers, and technology.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that the two layers refer specifically to the internal organisation of DPI-H application components, not to the complete layered architecture.
